data.topic: Find further improvements to command surfacing after the planned phases 005 to 008: better UX for the person and the model (what the hook brief says, when a command is offered, asked or started, the install and setup path for an external repository), better performance (hook time, embedder cost, cold start, token cost of the brief) and above all usefulness across the six CLIs (claude, codex, opencode, pi, devin, dsh): whether a model on each runtime actually starts an offered command, and what stops it.
